subject: Action plan: split-approval lanes for MSA/DPA + Order Form (target Dec 15)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Linda Hwang <linda.hwang@aureuslabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Action plan: split-approval lanes for MSA/DPA + Order Form (target Dec 15)

Hi Linda —

Quick note to line up a mutual-action plan so we can avoid the usual serial bottleneck between legal, security, and procurement. The team here has reviewed the evaluation notes and we think the fastest path to a Dec 15 close is to run the MSA and DPA in parallel and stage the order form signature behind a short security acceptance window (2–3 business days) rather than waiting for full procurement approval.

Proposed MAP highlights (attached as XLSX):
- Week 1 (Nov 23–27): Vendor risk completes evidence intake (SOC2 report, data flow diagram, retention table).
- Week 2 (Nov 30–Dec 4): Redwood legal to provide initial redline on MSA (target 3 business days from receipt).
- Week 2: DPA review to run concurrently with MSA — we can accept a DPA executed with a standard appendix while MSA remotes are finalized.
- Week 3 (Dec 7–11): Procurement sign-off on order form contingent on security acceptance; legal to sign MSA/DPA by Dec 11 where possible.
- Target Dec 15: DocuSign completion for Order Form + final evidence handoff.

Two asks from your side to keep us on track: 1) Confirm the internal Aureus reviewer(s) who will own vendor evidence and their availability window for a quick follow-up call next week; 2) Can procurement accept the order form contingent signature pattern (order form signed by procurement with DPA/limited appendix in place)?

Attachments: Aureus_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP milestones), redwood_evidence_manifest.pdf (evidence checklist).

If that plan looks viable, I’ll get Laura and Karthik to open the redline and flag any non-starters. Happy to hop on a 30-min sync — propose Nov 24 at 10am PT if that works.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Linda Hwang <linda.hwang@aureuslabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aureuslabs.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Action plan: split-approval lanes for MSA/DPA + Order Form (target Dec 15)

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear plan. I spoke with our vendor risk lead (copied via procurement alias) and we can run the evidence intake starting Monday. Quick notes from our side:
- Vendor risk will need the SOC2 (or compensating evidence) and a filled-out data flow diagram by Nov 30 to hit your timeline. We can triage the rest of the items after that date but evidence for PII handling is mandatory.
- Procurement is cautious about signing order forms before legal has a DPA in place, but we can accept a conditional signature where the order form is executed subject to DPA appendix being in DocuSign within 5 business days.

I can confirm ownership: Marcus Leung (vendorrisk@aureuslabs.com) will own evidence intake and can do a drop-in call Nov 24 at 10am PT. He prefers short, focused calls with concrete artifacts.

We’re attaching a short internal checklist for procurement intake (we’ll forward Marcus’ direct contact after the call).

—Linda
Head of Procurement, Aureus Labs
Linda.Hwang@aureuslabs.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Linda Hwang <linda.hwang@aureuslabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Action plan: split-approval lanes for MSA/DPA + Order Form (target Dec 15)

On Nov 22, 2026, at 11:03 AM, Linda Hwang wrote:
> Stephanie —
>
> Appreciate the clear plan. I spoke with our vendor risk lead (copied via procurement alias) and we can run the evidence intake starting Monday.

Thanks, Linda — this approach is workable from Redwood legal with a few guardrails. Key points from legal review (high level):
- We will draft an initial MSA redline this week (attached stub MSA_initial_redline.docx). Our turnaround target is 3 business days after receipt of any substantive counterparty redlines.
- For the DPA: we agree to run it concurrently. To avoid circular dependency, we propose a short execution pattern: Aureus executes a DPA execution copy (with standard appendix) in DocuSign simultaneously with an order form execution that is marked conditional (signature block to be activated when the DPA appendix is completed). That satisfies procurement needs while letting legal finish MSA iterations.
- If Aureus requests non-standard data transfer terms (e.g., onshore-only processing or deletion windows <30 days), flag now — those will require security sign-off and may delay the timeline.

I’ll coordinate the redline and post a summary of material open items in the HubSpot deal link. If Marcus can share the SOC2 report by Nov 30, we should be able to keep the current schedule.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Linda Hwang <linda.hwang@aureuslabs.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aureuslabs.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Action plan: split-approval lanes for MSA/DPA + Order Form (target Dec 15)

Laura / Stephanie —

Update after the vendor-risk intake call: Marcus confirmed he can deliver the SOC2 snapshot and DFD by Tue Nov 30 EOD. Procurement is comfortable with the conditional order-form execution pattern you described. We’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope for: (a) DPA execution copy + appendix, (b) Order Form marked conditional. If legal signs the MSA redline this week, we’re set to aim for Dec 15 DocuSign completion.

Two small asks for Redwood before we send the envelope:
1) Confirm the DocuSign contact for legal signature (who at Redwood will receive the envelope?)
2) Confirm any non-standard security requests now (so we can surface to Marcus) — you mentioned onshore-only processing as a potential blocker.

I’ll queue the envelope once we have answers and SOC2 in hand. Thanks for moving fast on this.

Best,
Linda Hwang
Head of Procurement, Aureus Labs
linda.hwang@aureuslabs.com
